result_scope: every lexically observed named theorem or lemma command

status_vocabulary.verification: Current theorem source is bound to a replay receipt.
status_vocabulary.verification pending: No current theorem replay receipt is bound.

nonclaims: A lexical command head is not a complete Lean declaration parse.
A result identity does not establish theorem validity, proof acceptance, originality or authorship.
Verification pending is not a failed theorem; it records the absence of a current replay receipt.
Anonymous examples, generated declarations and declarations not named on an observed command head are outside this lexical result scope.
